title: Act 4 - Chapter 3: The Apex Sandbox: Vermilion Arena, Level 100 League & Triple Fusions
synopsis: Step into the ultimate competitive proving grounds of Pokémon Infinite Fusion. Track all 16 Gym Leaders across Kanto, Johto, and the Sevii Islands as they appear in the overworld on designated days, accepting challenges for full 6 vs 6 competitive rematches at the Vermilion City Arena. Climb the final echelons of the Indigo Plateau to conquer Tier 4 and Tier 5 Elite Four Rematches scaling to a flat Level 100 cap. Finally, harness the post-Mt. Silver Super DNA Splicers to create legendary Triple Fusions (Zapmolcuno, Raienteicune, and Dialkiatina) with boosted base stats and unique typings.
